items.content_html: # MeraProduct 🇮🇳 MeraProduct is a lightweight Chrome extension built to empower users to make informed and patriotic purchase decisions. It automatically detects whether the product you’re viewing online is *Made in India* and displays key insights like origin, manufacturer, and review summaries.

items.content_html: FindEat is a lightweight web app built with pure JavaScript and Leaflet.js that helps users discover nearby restaurants on an interactive map. It integrates OpenStreetMap, Google Places, and Firebase to display details, reviews, and photos while caching data for faster and smarter browsing.
